help:
Usage: fullshield [options] [command]

Full-cycle security scanner for Node.js/TypeScript backends

Options:
  -V, --version                     output the version number
  --debug                           print stack traces on CLI errors
  -h, --help                        display help for command

Commands:
  scan [options] [path]             Scan a project directory for security
                                    findings
  fix [options] [path]              Propose or apply safe auto-fixes (dry-run
                                    by default)
  init [options] [path]             Write fullshield.config.json, CI workflows,
                                    and a pre-commit hook
  notify [options] [path]           Send a summary of the last scan (Slack,
                                    webhook, or SMTP)
  sbom [options] [path]             Write a CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM, or experimental
                                    SPDX 2.3 when enabled
  edge [options] <url>              Check CDN/WAF, TLS, headers, and common
                                    exposure paths on a URL you own
  watch [options] [path]            Rescan dependencies and alert only on NEW
                                    vulnerabilities
  threat-model [path]               Experimental STRIDE + Mermaid threat model
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_PLATFORM=1)
  report [options] [path]           Reports (experimental --serve dashboard;
                                    --compliance mapping)
  iac [path]                        Experimental IaC scan
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_IAC=1)
  mcp [options]                     Experimental MCP server (read-only;
                                    requires FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_MCP=1)
  explain [options] <id>            Print one finding from a scan JSON file
                                    (requires
                                    FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_EXPLAIN=1)
  deps-diff [options] <ref> [path]  Compare a lockfile at a git ref with the
                                    working tree (requires
                                    FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_DEPS_DIFF=1)
  deps [options] [path]             Dependency capability profile (requires
                                    FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_CAPABILITIES=1)
  confirm <url>                     Experimental exploit confirm
                                    (localhost/127.0.0.1/FullShield container
                                    only)
  install [options] <pkg>           Experimental install-guard (requires
                                    FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_SUPPLY=1)
  agent [options] [path]            Experimental remediation agent
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT=1).
                                    Mock/localhost API + local git only.
  host [options]                    Experimental host SSH exposure check (Linux
                                    only; FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_HOST=1)
  honey                             Experimental honeytokens (requires
                                    FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_HONEY=1)
  vex [options] [path]              Experimental VEX from reachability
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_VEX=1)
  diff [options] <before> <after>   Experimental comparison of two scan --json
                                    files (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_DIFF=1)
  ingest [options] <files...>       Ingest local SARIF, npm audit, OSV-Scanner,
                                    and Semgrep JSON
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_INGEST=1)
  dev [options] [path]              Watch the project and print new or resolved
                                    findings (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_DEV=1)
  npm-audit-diff [options]          Compare a local npm audit JSON file with
                                    scan findings (requires
                                    FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_NPM_AUDIT_DIFF=1)
  doctor [options] [path]           Report Node, lockfile, cache, flags,
                                    config, and whether OSV is offline
  help [command]                    display help for command
help.agent:
Usage: fullshield agent [options] [path]

Experimental remediation agent (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT=1).
Mock/localhost API + local git only.

Arguments:
  path           project directory (default: ".")

Options:
  --max-prs <n>  maximum pull requests to open (default: "3")
  -h, --help     display help for command
help.confirm:
Usage: fullshield confirm [options] <url>

Experimental exploit confirm (localhost/127.0.0.1/FullShield container only)

Arguments:
  url         target base URL

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
help.deps:
Usage: fullshield deps [options] [path]

Dependency capability profile (requires FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_CAPABILITIES=1)

Arguments:
  path            project directory (default: ".")

Options:
  --capabilities  print each direct dependency capability and who introduces it
  --json          print JSON
  -h, --help      display help for command
help.deps-diff:
Usage: fullshield deps-diff [options] <ref> [path]

Compare a lockfile at a git ref with the working tree (requires
FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_DEPS_DIFF=1)

Arguments:
  ref                   git ref to read with git show
  path                  project directory (default: ".")

Options:
  --json                print JSON
  --fail-on <severity>  exit 1 when an introduced advisory is at or above this
                        severity
  --offline             use the OSV cache only
  -h, --help            display help for command
help.dev:
Usage: fullshield dev [options] [path]

Watch the project and print new or resolved findings
(FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_DEV=1)

Arguments:
  path                  project directory (default: ".")

Options:
  --poll-interval <ms>  poll interval when recursive fs.watch is unavailable
  -h, --help            display help for command
help.diff:
Usage: fullshield diff [options] <before> <after>

Experimental comparison of two scan --json files
(FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_DIFF=1)

Arguments:
  before                earlier scan JSON
  after                 later scan JSON

Options:
  --experimental-diff   enable this command (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_DIFF=1)
  --json                print the machine diff
  --out <file>          write the machine diff to this file
  --fail-on <severity>  exit 1 when an added finding is at or above this
                        severity (default: "high")
  -h, --help            display help for command
help.doctor:
Usage: fullshield doctor [options] [path]

Report Node, lockfile, cache, flags, config, and whether OSV is offline

Arguments:
  path             project directory (default: ".")

Options:
  --offline        do not describe OSV as allowed to use the network
  --config <file>  explicit config file
  -h, --help       display help for command
help.edge:
Usage: fullshield edge [options] <url>

Check CDN/WAF, TLS, headers, and common exposure paths on a URL you own

Arguments:
  url         https URL to probe (GET/HEAD only; no crawl)

Options:
  --json      machine-readable JSON output
  -h, --help  display help for command
help.explain:
Usage: fullshield explain [options] <id>

Print one finding from a scan JSON file (requires
FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_EXPLAIN=1)

Arguments:
  id                         finding id or a prefix of at least 6 characters

Options:
  --from <file>              scan --json file
  --experimental-fix-verify  re-scan the suggested diff in memory
                             (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_FIX_VERIFY=1)
  -h, --help                 display help for command
help.fix:
Usage: fullshield fix [options] [path]

Propose or apply safe auto-fixes (dry-run by default)

Arguments:
  path                       directory to fix (default: ".")

Options:
  --apply                    write safe fixes (requires a clean git tree)
  --force                    apply even if the tree is dirty or not a git repo
  --unsafe                   include major-version bumps and code patches
                             marked unsafe
  --no-branch                do not create a fullshield/fixes-* branch
  --modules <modules>        comma-separated subset of modules to scan
  --experimental-fix-verify  re-scan each patch in memory
                             (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_FIX_VERIFY=1)
  --force-unverified         write a patch that does not remove its finding
  --yes                      does not write a patch that introduces a finding
  --ai                       draft a verified patch for findings without a
                             rule-based fix (reviewable diff only)
  -h, --help                 display help for command

                                it
  --experimental-spdx           enable experimental SPDX 2.3
                                (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_SPDX=1)
  -h, --help                    display help for command
help.scan:
Usage: fullshield scan [options] [path]

Scan a project directory for security findings

Arguments:
  path                              directory to scan (default: ".")

Options:
  --json                            machine-readable JSON output
  --all                             print every finding in the console, with no
                                    20-row cap
  --fail-on <severity>              exit 1 if any finding is at or above this
                                    severity
  --max-time <seconds>              experimental: stop at this many seconds
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_BUDGET=1). An
                                    incomplete scan is not clean
  --experimental-budget             experimental: time budget and partial
                                    results (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_BUDGET=1)
  --modules <modules>               comma-separated subset of modules to run
  --staged                          scan only files staged in git (pre-commit
                                    mode)
  --offline                         use the OSV cache only (no network)
  --offline-safe                    alias of --offline
  --config <path>                   path to fullshield.config.json
  --sarif <file>                    write a SARIF 2.1.0 report to this path
  --markdown <file>                 write a Markdown report to this path
  --html <file>                     write an HTML report to this path
  --experimental-ci-reports         experimental: GitHub annotations, JUnit,
                                    and GitLab Code Quality
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_CI_REPORTS=1)
  --github-annotations <file>       experimental: GitHub Actions workflow
                                    commands (requires
                                    FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_CI_REPORTS=1)
  --junit <file>                    experimental: JUnit XML (requires
                                    FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_CI_REPORTS=1)
  --gitlab <file>                   experimental: GitLab Code Quality JSON
                                    (requires
                                    FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_CI_REPORTS=1)
  --update-baseline                 record current findings as accepted (CI
                                    fails only on new ones)
  --ai [mode]                       experimental: explain findings (off = zero
                                    AI network calls)
  --emit-virtual-patches [file]     experimental: write
                                    .fullshield/vpatches.json
  --changed                         experimental: scan git staged/changed files
                                    only
  --since <ref>                     experimental: scan files changed since a
                                    git ref
  --experimental-sast-gaps          experimental: ORM raw / sh -c / execa / zx
                                    sinks (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_SAST_GAPS=1)
  --experimental-frameworks         experimental: Next.js / NestJS / Hono / Koa
                                    taint + AUTH
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_FRAMEWORKS=1)
  --experimental-classes            experimental:
                                    ReDoS/deser/XXE/upload/cookie/CSRF/mass-assign/timing/hash/GQL/trust-proxy
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_CLASSES=1)
  --experimental-secrets-adv        experimental: history/bundle/verify-secrets
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_SECRETS_ADV=1)
  --history                         experimental: scan git history for secrets
                                    (requires
                                    FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_SECRETS_ADV=1)
  --bundle <dir>                    experimental: scan a built client bundle
                                    for browser-exposed keys (requires
                                    FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_SECRETS_ADV=1)
  --verify-secrets                  experimental: check whether detected keys
                                    are live (never default; requires
                                    --i-own-these-credentials)
  --i-own-these-credentials         required with --verify-secrets: you own
                                    these credentials; read-only identity
                                    checks only
  --experimental-vex                experimental: worm/workflow indicators,
                                    overrides, provenance, VEX
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_VEX=1)
  --experimental-reach-evidence     experimental: record why a dependency
                                    reachability class was chosen
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_REACH_EVIDENCE=1)
  --experimental-lockfiles          experimental: yarn berry, pnpm v9, and
                                    bun.lock
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_LOCKFILES=1)
  --experimental-supply             experimental: supply-chain campaign
                                    heuristics
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_SUPPLY=1)
  --experimental-workspaces         experimental: scan each workspace lockfile
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_WORKSPACES=1)
  --experimental-sarif-v2           experimental: extra SARIF fields
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_SARIF_V2=1)
  --experimental-custom-sanitizers  experimental: config-declared sources and
                                    sanitizers
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_CUSTOM_SANITIZERS=1)
  --experimental-validation         experimental: route schema validation
                                    inference
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_VALIDATION=1)
  --experimental-types              experimental: suppress non-sink receivers
                                    with the TypeScript checker
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_TYPES=1)
  --experimental-models             experimental: library model packs
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_MODELS=1)
  --taint-summaries                 cache per-function taint summaries
                                    (FULLSHIELD_TAINT_SUMMARIES=1)
  --experimental-paths              experimental: attack paths from existing
                                    findings (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_PATHS=1)
  --paths                           add a paths section (requires
                                    FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_PATHS=1)
  --experimental-mcpcfg             experimental: MCP client/server config
                                    rules (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_MCPCFG=1)
  --experimental-priority           experimental: deterministic priority score
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_PRIORITY=1)
  --experimental-semgrep-rules      experimental: user-supplied Semgrep-style
                                    rules
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_SEMGREP_RULES=1)
  --semgrep-rules <file>            experimental: YAML rules file (requires
                                    FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_SEMGREP_RULES=1)
  --include-home                    experimental: also scan MCP configs in the
                                    home directory (requires
                                    FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_MCPCFG=1)
  --pr-summary                      experimental: deterministic Markdown of new
                                    findings versus baseline
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_POLICY=1)
  --experimental-capabilities       experimental: dependency capability profile
                                    (FULLSHIELD_EXPERIMENTAL_CAPABILITIES=1)
  -h, --help                        display help for command
